title: Timetable

musical.notes: Machinery rather than mood — a plan admiring itself. Picks up the pizzicato ticking cue B hands over, so the pulse never stops between them.

provenance.prompt: Instrumental underscore, 60 BPM, D dorian. A mechanical ostinato: low piano, pizzicato double basses and bowed vibraphone interlocking like clockwork being wound. Precise, cool and unemotional, closer to a study than a mood. The three-note figure passes between instruments without ever landing. Slight ritardando at the end, gears settling.
